mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries allows the model to contain a decided application whose EvtSubmitted audit entry is absent, directly violating the append-only invariant. The injection forces exactly such a state to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some a: LoanApplication | (a.status = AppStatusApproved or a.status = AppStatusRejected) and (no e: AuditEntry | e.auditApp = a and e.eventType = EvtSubmitted) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_OnePendingPerCustomer allows two distinct applications for the same customer to both be in PendingReview simultaneously, violating FR-005. The injection forces this state.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OnePendingViolation { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.appCustomer = a2.appCustomer and a1.status = PendingReview and a2.status = PendingReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AtMostOneDecisionPerApplication allows two Decision atoms pointing to the same LoanApplication, modelling the concurrent double-decision race that FR-012 and FR-011 prohibit.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DoubleDecisionViolation { some disj d1, d2: Decision | d1.decApp = d2.decApp }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_LeastPrivilege allows an Operation whose caller's role is denied for that OperationKind (e.g., a Customer calling PostDecision). The injection forces exactly such a forbidden operation to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation | op.caller.role = Customer and op.kind = PostDecision }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditDecisionEntry allows a decided application to have no decision audit entry at all, breaking the AuditCompleteness and AttributionCorrectness invariants. The injection forces a decided app with no EvtApproved/EvtRejected entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingDecisionAudit { some a: LoanApplication | a.status = AppStatusApproved and (no e: AuditEntry | e.auditApp = a and (e.eventType = EvtApproved or e.eventType = EvtRejected)) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_OwnershipBasedAccess allows a Customer-role Operation to target an application owned by a different customer, violating FR-013 and NoInformationLeakage. The injection forces a cross-customer access operation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossCustomerAccess { some op: Operation, a: LoanApplication | op.caller.role = Customer and op.kind = GetApplicationByRef and op.targetApp = a and a.appCustomer != op.caller }
